title: Sap S/4Hana Security & Authorisation Manager
description:
SAP S/4HANA Security & Authorisation Manager Mars•Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Descrição da vaga

SAP S / 4HANA Security and Authorisation Manager | Digital Core Locations : Slough, UK - Sao Paolo, Brazil - Warsaw, Poland

As we work to transform and optimise Mars, a new program has been mobilised by the Mars leadership team. The program is focused on the design and implementation of SAP S / 4HANA in Mars across Segments (Petcare, Corporate, Snacking & Food). Much more than a simple “Lift and Shift,” this program will undertake a major process simplification and harmonisation scope as we digitally transform our business.

The program focuses primarily on eight mega process areas : Finance, Source to Pay (procurement and vendor mgmt.), Plan to Fulfil (manufacturing and distribution), Lead to Cash (sales order processing and payment), Governance, Engage to Consume (marketing), Idea to Market (R&D), and Recruit to Retire (HR). This transformation requires thought leadership, quality decision making, deep technical know-how, and an ability to navigate complex business challenges while applying a holistic and multi-disciplinary approach to each of these mega processes.

As part of the program, four new positions have been created to manage all core Security and Compliance activities related to the SAP S / 4HANA landscape.

Collectively the new roles will be responsible for the delivery of the core SAP Security deliverables within S / 4HANA and FIORI ensuring alignment with role design, processes and governance principles.

Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate and exemplify the Five Principles of Mars, Inc. personally and within the team.
  • Support the SAP Security team in ensuring that shared and local / segment template security requirements are adopted across business segments while incorporating segment-specific needs into the shared template or localising them as necessary.
  • Analyse and understand the security requirements and risks of a complex ERP environment that underpins critical business and IT processes.
  • Work with the SAP Security team and Global Process Owners (GPO’s) in implementing a comprehensive SAP Security and GRC framework, including strategies, policies, and procedures that align with organisational objectives and industry best practices to ensure robust access controls, risk management and regulatory compliance.
  • Design and deliver technical and functional solutions against specifications in accordance with agreed standards and procedures.
  • Follow standards and procedure for user provisioning, de-provisioning, and segregation of duties.
  • Lead and support multiple testing phases – including build unit tests (BUT) security unit tests (SUT) system integration tests (SIT) and user acceptance tests (UAT) by leveraging Mars current test tools to ensure robust SAP security and system integrity.

description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1,200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

We are hiring a technical engineering manager to redefine the embedded Linux experience with the smallest, most secure, and most reliable operating system in the IoT market.

This is an opportunity for a technical leader passionate about open‑source software, Linux, containers, security, and the developer experience, to shape the future of Linux from the smallest systems up to desktops. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill as well as high caliber for inspiring and driving people.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next‑generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardize the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an engineering manager, you’ll lead a team of strong software developers to design and implement Ubuntu Core system software on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC‑V, and X86. You will meet stakeholders, prioritize requests, plan the roadmap, and ensure the team can deliver their goals. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The role entails

  • Building and leading a distributed team of engineers through hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback and career development
  • Demonstrating sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Coaching and mentoring team members with hands‑on career development
  • Effectively setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocating and advancing modern, agile software development practices and helping develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Contributing to a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Actively participating in the leadership team and collaborating with other leaders in the organization

What we are looking for in you

  • Demonstrated competencies in embedded software development
  • Strong skills in Golang, C++ and Shell
  • A solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Love for developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • Demonstrated ability of planning and executing to deliver high quality software in a timely manner
  • Solid experience working in an agile development environment
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Familiarity with an immutable Linux distribution, preferably Ubuntu Core
  • Experience with multiple CPU architectures such as ARM, RISC‑V
  • Experience with Linux native containerization and security

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
Sobre o Hospital Municipal Pedro II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Planejar, implementar e monitorar a distribuição de medicamentos, produtos e materiais nas diversas unidades do hospital, orientando sobre dados técnicos, tais como: dosagem, fórmula farmacêutica, composição química, substitutos etc; produzir; executar a guardar e controlar a distribuição de medicamentos; realizar controle diário dos estoques.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia.
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Farmácia Clínica, Atenção Farmacêutica ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Farmacêutico na área da saúde.

Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionem a tomada de decisões.

Jornada de Trabalho

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.

Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Nossa Cultura

Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base desse princípio.

Sobre o Grupo Profarma

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Em 2013, ampliamos nossa atuação para o varejo farmacêutico por meio da Rede d1000, composta por mais de 270 lojas sob as bandeiras Drogasmil, Farmalife, Drogarias Tamoio e Drogaria Rosário.

Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem‑estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma

Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura de TI II
description:
Overview

O que buscamos? Buscamos um profissional de Infraestrutura de TI, capaz de administrar e evoluir ambientes on-premises e em nuvem, garantindo disponibilidade, segurança e desempenho dos serviços, com sólida base em Windows, Linux, redes, virtualização e segurança, bem como interesse em automação, padronização e boas práticas, boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa apoiando a modernização contínua da infraestrutura e o crescimento do negócio.

Atribuições Principais

  • Prestar suporte aos usuários nos atendimentos de média complexidade;
  • Garantir o funcionamento do software e hardware de toda infraestrutura de redes, servidor, banco de dados de um projeto ou sistema;
  • Realizar a manutenção preventivas para garantir a segurança de dados;
  • Criar políticas de backup e segurança;
  • Prevenir contra invasões físicas ou lógicas e mapear todos esses procedimentos técnicos;
  • Instalar, configurar e atualizar softwares, esclarecendo dúvidas e fornecendo requisitos necessários para o funcionamento adequado de infraestruturas de redes;
  • Ser interface com o time de sustentação e participar de reuniões técnicas e de crise para resolução de incidentes críticos;
  • Documentar procedimentos pertinentes a operação de monitoração e suporte de TI;
  • Criar usuários nos sistemas e fazer manutenção de grupos para concessão de privilégios com permissão de acesso;
  • Levantar feedbacks sobre processos visando melhoria contínua;
  • Zelar pelo atendimento ao usuário e por manter a lista de atendimentos dentro do SLA.

Requisitos

  • Administração de ambientes Windows Server, incluindo Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, Group Policy Objects (GPO) e WSUS.
  • Administração de sistemas Linux (Debian, CentOS, Ubuntu ou RedHat), com experiência em gerenciamento de permissões, pacotes e shell scripting (Bash).
  • Domínio de protocolos de rede, incluindo TCP/IP, roteamento, sub-redes e VLANs.
  • Conhecimento em hardware de rede, com configuração de switches (Cisco, HP, Dell), roteadores e Access Points.
  • Experiência na configuração e suporte a serviços de rede, como VPN (IPsec, OpenVPN), Proxy e balanceadores de carga.
  • Vivência com serviços em nuvem, incluindo gestão de instâncias (EC2/VMs), armazenamento (S3/Blob Storage) e redes virtuais (VPC).
  • Conhecimento em virtualização, utilizando ferramentas como VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V ou Nutanix.
  • Experiência em storage, com gerenciamento de ambientes NAS e SAN, protocolos iSCSI e Fibre Channel, além da gestão de LUNs.
  • Configuração e administração de firewalls, como Fortinet, Cisco ASA, pfSense ou SonicWall.
  • Implementação e gestão de rotinas de backup, políticas de retenção e ferramentas como Veeam Backup & Replication, Veritas ou Commvault.
  • Experiência com monitoramento de ambientes, utilizando ferramentas como Zabbix, Nagios, Grafana ou PRTG.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento básico em Infrastructure as Code (IaC), com utilização de ferramentas como Terraform ou Ansible.
  • Noções de containers, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de script, como PowerShell ou Python, para automação de tarefas rotineiras.

Localidade da posição

Híbrido no Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo a Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais cresce no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Quais são nossos valores?

  • Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
  • Pensamos e agimos como donos
  • Temos gana por performance
  • Crescemos e aprendemos juntos

  • Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

title: Operador de Produção
description:
Overview

Important! To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on (dd.mm.yyyy):

We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

What does the job involve?

O Operador de Produção é responsável pela operação segura, eficiente e confiável dos sistemas de processo e utilidades do FPSO, garantindo operações de produção suaves. O operador assegura que as metas de produção sejam atendidas, mantendo a conformidade com os procedimentos de segurança, ambientais e operacionais.

What will my tasks be?

Within This Position, Your Key Tasks Will Be To

  • Monitorar com precisão as variáveis do processo (pressão, nível, temperatura, vazão), comprometendo-se a ajudar os operadores da sala de controle a entender as tendências do processo, colaborando com ideias técnicas para otimização da produção e sugestões para garantir a estabilidade da planta de processo.
  • Operar sistemas de Óleo e Gás com compromisso, garantindo a produção de óleo dentro das especificações e os parâmetros legais para a descarga de água produzida.
  • Participar ativamente da manutenção de primeira linha, executando ordens de trabalho preventivas, tarefas de preservação e prevenção de corrosão.
  • Procurar proativamente por falhas de equipamento, identificar falhas e fornecer soluções práticas e imediatas para evitar interrupções.
  • Relatar problemas técnicos identificados em campo com explicações detalhadas e fotos usando um processador de texto. Levantar notificações de falha no SAP.
  • Monitorar o sistema de detecção de incêndio e gás, garantir que os detectores estejam livres de obstruções, assegurar que o sistema de combate a incêndios esteja operacional e preservado, cooperar com a equipe de resposta a emergências sempre que necessário.
  • Acompanhar os fornecedores durante suas atividades para garantir o cumprimento das ordens de trabalho com qualidade e segurança.
  • Seguir os procedimentos de Permissão para Trabalhar (PTW) e gestão de riscos.

Here's What We Expect From You

At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:

  • Diploma de Técnico e/ou Engenheiro em areas correlatas é obrigatorio.
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência com entregas comprovadas, preferencialmente experiência em campos pré-sal.
  • Fluente em português verbal e escrito e capaz de entender documentação técnica em inglês.
  • Fortes habilidades interpessoais.
  • Conhecimento de SAP e sistema de permissão para trabalhar pode ser considerado uma vantagem.
  • Experiência anterior com produção de energia em Ciclo Combinado, manuseio de vapor, compressão de gás, tratamento de gás e reinjeção, bem como árvore de natal molhada é um diferencial.
  • Valoriza a cooperação e a colaboração aberta como formas essenciais de trabalho. Proativo por natureza, toma iniciativa e pode trabalhar de forma independente quando necessário. Oferece e recebe feedback construtivo e é motivado pela melhoria contínua.
  • Ser um modelo de segurança, diversidade e inclusão.

What can we offer you?

We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That’s why we offer:

Not just a job - a career

In Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.

Attractive rewards

We give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.

Wellness and work-life balance

We care about and prioritise our employees’ well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That’s why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible.

An inclusive culture

We believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Equinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status.

As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact to see how we can support your needs.

Important notes about the application process

We expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process. Background checks are performed on all final candidates, and all permanent and temporary hires will be screened using relevant sanctions lists to ensure compliance with sanctions laws. When applying for a job in Norway you will be asked for information on affiliation to high-risk countries for a security assessment.

About Equinor

Equinor is an international energy company headquartered in Norway, energising the lives of 170 million people worldwide. Our ambition is to be a leading company in the energy transition and achieve net zero by 2050. Our task is enormous: supplying the world with the energy it needs, while lowering emissions to the atmosphere. To achieve it, we are looking for like-minded people to join our team of 25,000 colleagues working in more than 20 countries. We’re up for the challenge. Are you?

O app permite que usuários consultem e interpretem rótulos de cosméticos, identificando ingredientes potencialmente problemáticos, alergênicos ou controversos, com base em literatura científica , dados regulatórios e critérios técnicos claros.

Nós temos o objetivo de democratizar o acesso à informação , sem influência da indústria cosmética, ajudando famílias a fazer escolhas mais seguras e conscientes.

O aplicativo já está lançado, possui usuários ativos e faturamento inicial.

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa organizada, atenta a detalhes e com boa comunicação escrita para atuar em uma função operacional e essencial do dia a dia do app, unindo suporte ao cliente, organização de dados e curadoria de informações .

Principais responsabilidades

  • Validação e curadoria de cosméticos
    • Coletar dados de produtos enviados pelos usuários (nome, marca, ingredientes, categoria etc.)

    • Organizar e padronizar dados em planilhas
    • Revisar informações lendo artigos científicos de saúde, cosméticos
  • Organização e gestão de dados
    • Criar, manter e organizar planilhas em Excel
    • Trabalhar com listas estruturadas de produtos, ingredientes e categorias
    • Garantir consistência, padronização e qualidade dos dados
    • Atualizar bases conforme novos envios e revisões
  • Suporte ao cliente
    • Responder e-mails de usuários de forma clara, educada e objetiva
    • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre funcionamento do app, assinaturas e interpretação de informações
    • Registrar e organizar feedbacks recorrentes dos usuários
  • Comunicação com usuários
    • Organizar listas de e-mail marketing (Brevo)
    • Apoiar disparos de comunicações e notificações aos usuários

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Advocacy e Articulação Institucional: apoiar a elaboração de relatórios médicos para fins de advocacy, identificar atores estratégicos em coordenação com o Departamento de Advocacy e acompanhar o/a Coordenador(a) Médico(a) em reuniões institucionais com o SUS e outras organizações, quando solicitado.

A MSF busca pessoas comprometidas com uma cultura de salvaguarda, promovendo um ambiente seguro, ético e acolhedor para todas. Valorizamos profundamente a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações. Candidaturas alinhadas a esses valores serão altamente consideradas.

title: Quality Data Engineer (IDMC)
description:
Introduction

In this role, you'll work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities

This position is for talented and experienced Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) . In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, volume, and accuracy of data across on‑prem and cloud environments. You will validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using IDMC, collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for data pipelines and workflows built with IDMC.
  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.
  • Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Document test plans, results, and findings in a structured and traceable manner.
  • Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.
  • Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication.
  • Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.
  • Apply IDMC coding skills, including creating end‑to‑end mappings with Filters, Routers, and Joiners.
  • Work with JSON structures, filters, and parsers to validate and transform data.
  • Apply basic Java knowledge to support custom code requirements.
  • Use Python to read and process data from various file formats, leveraging functions and libraries such as Pandas.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong background in software product development and delivery.
  • Solid expertise in SQL for data validation and transformation.
  • Proven ability to design and execute data test plans, scenarios, and cases, with clear documentation of results.
  • Strong knowledge of Informatica IDMC or related data management tools.
  • Experience with Azure Cloud technologies such as ADF and PySpark.
  • Proficiency in Python and data libraries (e.g., Pandas).
  • Ability to interpret and create System & Architecture diagrams.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in cross‑functional teams.
  • Background in Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices.

Minimum Position Qualifications / Education Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or related information technology field from an accredited institution or equivalent work experience.
  • 6+ years of software product development and delivery experience.
  • 5+ years of SQL experience.
  • 3+ years of IDMC tool or related experience.
  • 3+ years’ experience overseeing the development of data test plans, test scenarios, test cases, execution of test case and documentation of test results.
  • 2+ years of experience in some of the Azure Cloud tools: ADF, Pyspark.
  • Experience with Python and libraries like Pandas.
  • Ability to interpret and draw System & Architecture diagrams.
  • Familiar with latest cloud technologies.

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Senior Software Developper calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

As a senior software engineer, you will have an opportunity to apply your versatile embedded, systems, and application software development skills to UCOS’s expanding use in myriad industrial controls and automation systems and Industrial IoT.You will lead and collaborate with other engineers while contributing at all phases of the software development lifecycle.

Job Description

  • Architect, design, implement, test and deliver high quality, performant software products.
  • Work cross functionally with software, application, and quality engineers to ensure products meet engineering and client success criteria.
  • Actively participate in the definition and implementation of new processes and improvements
  • Identify and create new technologies and ideas to increase the organization’s intellectual property and to better address customer needs.
  • Present your designs and solutions to internal and external teams and review designs of software and quality engineers.
  • Develop test plans and test automation processes to increase automated functional tests.
  • Mentor team in development/test technologies, tools, and processes

You are meant for this job if:

  • Requires a Bachelor of Science degree or related
  • Expertise in software engineering
  • Expert experience in C/C++, developing embedded software and systems software
  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (such as Docker), Kubernetes technologies (such K3S, Helm charts, Rancher), and IoT protocols (MQTT, REST API, Kafka)
  • Knowledge of cloud technologies such as AWS
  • Systems software programming knowledge of Windows and Linux OS
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft MFC (Microsoft Foundation Class), WPF, Qt, or similar GUI framework
  • Understanding of database technologies such as SQL, ODBC, and relational database schema design
  • Understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP), wired interfaces (Ethernet, USB), and wireless interfaces (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Cell, Satellite)
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining APIs for internal/external services
  • Exposure to the principals of Industrial Protocols, Platforms and APIs: OPC (DA & UA), Profibus, Profinet, Modbus (RTU, TCP, Enron), EtherIP, etc.
  • Exposure to serial communication protocols (I2C, RS-485, RS-232, CAN, SPI)
  • Exposure to industry standard embedded design and debugging tools is a plus (JTAG, protocol analyzers, emulators)
  • Exposure to Configuration Management tools (Version control, bug tracking, change management, automated builds, and coding standards)
  • Exposure to developing in agile and Iterative Software development processes
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

title: Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include leading public cloud and silicon providers and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical is a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business. This role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large, complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.

You will be managing projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs and/or EMEA regions.

Responsibilities

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects

What we are looking for in you

  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Benefits

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Requirements and skills

Formação de acordo com a função exercida;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área de atuação

Laudo médico válido e carimbado por médico especialista.

Additional information

Hospital Municipal Pedro II

Bairro: Santa Cruz

The Senior Software Developer calls for an experienced, knowledgeable, and talented individual to design and develop software for the User Configurable Open System (UCOS) product.

  • Deep knowledge of object-oriented programming and experience with at least one of (Java, C#, Python, Ruby).

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027").

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which assets are provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities; movements of team luggage and equipment to/from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managing the entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including unloading/loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where/if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site/venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

Your profile

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Overview

The Research and Development Department includes three clusters of disease expert teams: NTD Mycetoma and Leishmaniasis; NTD Chagas, Filarial, and HAT; and Viral Diseases. DNDi established its Latin American office in Rio de Janeiro in 2004. Since then, DNDi Latin America has contributed to advancing R&D and access partnerships across the region’s health ecosystems, focusing on neglected diseases such as Chagas disease, leishmaniasis, hepatitis C, and dengue. The office leads advocacy efforts and drives capacity-building initiatives through multi-country clinical research and drug discovery platforms.

The Trial Master File Management Officer is responsible for compiling, maintaining and archiving all TMF related documents to prepare submissions to international authorities for drug registrations, and to comply with DNDi’s SOPs and GCP requirements for filing and archiving of clinical trials. The incumbent will plan and coordinate the overall management of the Trial Master Files and associated processes following GCP and ICH, including system and tool development, business process documentation, and ensuring inspection readiness for the TMF across all Disease Programme/Cluster.

Responsibilities

  • Manage document control processes and systems for GCP activities in compliance with internal procedures and policies; ensure compliance with ICH/GCP and relevant international and local legislation and regulations.
  • Assess suitability of documentation for filing (accuracy, completeness, and legibility).
  • Ensure high quality Trial Master File setup and management (on-boarding of study contributors, completion of the TMF management plan, study-specific preparation of documents in the system, periodic reviews, etc.).
  • Serve as a Trial Master File contact for documentation to the project team and cross-functional departments.
  • Follow up on open record management queries and ensure their full resolution.
  • Assist in periodic Trial Master File audits.
  • Plan and perform internal periodic quality check activities of the TMF, provide findings to the clinical team and support to ensure compliance with internal and external quality standards.
  • Provide support to clinical teams during regulatory inspections for record organization and retrieval.
  • Continuously monitor, identify and report quality problems and record management work practices; make recommendations for resolutions and initiate actions required to resolve quality and efficiency problems.

Additional / Specific Projects / Responsibilities

  • Support the creation and/or update of applicable SOPs, Guidance Documents, templates etc., as applicable.
  • Continuously oversee and identify opportunities for improvement in document management processes, particularly archiving management; support implementation activities as applicable.
  • TMF Officer reports to Senior Clinical Project Manager.
  • Works with all teams and all units in all departments.
  • Coordinate with external contacts under supervision; support information exchange.
  • First university degree (Bachelor level) in a relevant field if required by the function.
  • At least 3 years of experience or equivalent internship/training in the area.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a team environment and matrix structure.
  • Experience working in the public and private sector is highly desirable.

Critical Skills And Attributes

  • Emerging technical skills in a defined field.
  • Ability to support standard and routine activities independently.
  • Willingness to learn and apply feedback to evolve into higher-level specialist roles.
  • Ability to use initiative, prioritize, multi-task, and work well under pressure to meet deadlines.
  • Clear and systematic thinking that demonstrates good judgment and problem solving competencies.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multicultural team.
  • Well organized and structured.
  • Good analytical skills.
  • Provide specialist services to operational line or project team.
  • Ability to solve non-routine problems on a case by case/project basis.
  • Has a certain autonomy for taking actions and decisions.

R&D Technical Skills

  • Good knowledge of regulatory (GCP, GLP and GMP), particularly in TMF management.
  • Strong technical writing skills (procedures, protocols and reports).
  • Fluency in English.
  • Proficiency in local languages desirable.
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Suite.
  • Good knowledge of Veeva (eTMF maintenance, improvement, review release, set-up, etc.).

DNDi is committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive organisation. Our success and global reach depend on our ability to encourage diversity and draw on the skills, understanding and experience of all our people. We particularly welcome applications from those who are underrepresented at DNDi and across the sector, especially women, including Black and minority ethnic candidates and those with other protected characteristics.

description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior/Lead Full-Stack Engineer, you will help build a financial intelligence platform designed for AI consumption, turning complex data into actionable insights. This is a full-time role starting with a focused 6‑month project, offering strong autonomy and fast execution in a product‑driven environment. You will act as a hands‑on utility player, working across frontend, backend, integrations, and light architecture while shaping a cohesive, customer‑ready system. Successful delivery opens the opportunity to continue on other impactful projects.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the implementation and integration of existing product components, including AI usage dashboards and advisor insights;
  • Design and build backend functionality to support billing rules, chargeback logic, and ROI calculation for AI usage;
  • Integrate external billing data sources, starting with cloud billing systems;
  • Build and evolve APIs and data pipelines that translate raw billing data into usable financial insights;
  • Implement frontend functionality to surface metrics, dashboards, and data‑heavy UI views clearly and pragmatically;
  • Make sound architectural decisions at a medium level of complexity, prioritizing maintainability and speed;
  • Collaborate closely with product stakeholders, operating with minimal process overhead;
  • Ensure smooth deployment and delivery workflows using Vercel;
  • Contribute to overall product cohesion by connecting disparate parts into a single, usable experience;
  • Work full‑time on a 6‑month project, with the opportunity to continue on other projects afterward.

MUST HAVES

  • 4+ years of experience and strong full‑stack background with proven ability to move across frontend, backend, and integrations;
  • Solid experience with Python and Node.js in production environments;
  • Experience designing and working with PostgreSQL schemas and data models ;
  • Direct experience integrating cloud billing systems or similar cost and usage APIs ;
  • Experience building frontend applications deployed via Vercel (React or similar frameworks);
  • Strong experience consuming and integrating third‑party APIs, especially billing or usage‑based systems;
  • Demonstrated ability to work with incomplete requirements and turn them into working solutions;
  • Comfortable operating in early‑stage product environments with limited structure;
  • Professional working proficiency in English;
  • Experience integrating frontend tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar);
  • Familiarity with observability and usage tracking concepts (e.g., OpenTelemetry or similar telemetry systems);
  • Experience building or consuming SDKs.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with PHP;
  • Experience building financial, billing, or cost‑allocation systems;
  • Familiarity with AI usage metrics, token‑based billing, or ROI tracking models;
  • Experience working on dashboards, tables, filters, and data‑dense UI patterns;
  • Prior startup or founder‑led product experience;
  • Exposure to AI tooling workflows.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD‑based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

  • Proven ability to own project development end-to-end, including requirements gathering, architecture design, coding, testing, and deployment.

  • Advanced English communication skills, written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with globally distributed cross-functional teams.


Bonus Points If



  • Experience leading the technical direction of complex, cross-functional projects with multiple dependencies.

description:
Job description

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Main responsibilities

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo de ações da atenção básica. Promover ações que propiciem a redução de incapacidades e deficiências com vistas à melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos, favorecendo sua reinserção social, combatendo a discriminação e ampliando o acesso ao sistema de saúde. Formular projetos terapêuticos únicos que considerem a pessoa, suas necessidades e o significado da deficiência no contexto familiar e social.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência com CEDTEA, para atender crianças em Reabilitação Intelectual;

title: Senior Director Cybersecurity
description:
Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Cybersecurity will oversee and enhance the university's cybersecurity program within a sophisticated hybrid IT environment. This position combines visionary leadership typical of a cybersecurity executive with extensive technical expertise similar to that of a Security Architect and Engineer. The Senior Director will have primary accountability for securing the university's systems, applications, networks, and data, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, and guiding technical teams in initiatives focused on threat prevention and mitigation.

Supervisory Authority

The Senior Director of Cybersecurity will supervise a team of cybersecurity professionals, including managers, engineers, and analysts. This position holds the authority to make decisions regarding hiring, training, performance evaluations, and disciplinary actions within the cybersecurity department.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, students and staff of the department and University and Howard University Hospital CIO. External contacts include vendors, consultants, investigators, auditors, etc. Collaborate closely with the Chief Audit and Compliance Officer.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Develop and execute a university-wide cybersecurity strategy that aligns with Howard University’s goals and emerging threat landscapes
  • Lead cross-functional cybersecurity governance initiatives, partnering with senior academic and administrative leaders to promote a security-first culture
  • Design, implement, and continuously evolve a secure infrastructure architecture across hybrid environments (on-premises and Azure cloud), including identity management (Entra ID), network segmentation, Zero Trust, and secure access
  • Evaluate and select enterprise-class security solutions: firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel), endpoint detection and response (EDR), encryption, and data loss prevention (DLP)
  • Conduct architectural risk analysis, threat modeling, and develop mitigation strategies for new and existing systems and applications
  • Ensure identity and access management (IAM) policies align with least privilege and role-based access control principles
  • Oversee real-time security monitoring, incident detection, and coordinated incident response efforts, utilizing SIEM and SOAR platforms
  • Drive security assessments, penetration tests, and red/blue team exercises to proactively identify and resolve vulnerabilities
  • Manage vulnerability management programs and ensure timely patch management across all systems
  • Maintain and test business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) plans related to information security incidents
  • Coordinate with other departments to integrate cybersecurity measures into business processes
  • Monitor and analyze security metrics to provide insights and recommendations to senior leadership
  • Stay informed about the latest cybersecurity trends, threats, and technologies

Core Competencies

Expert experience in the following:

  • Windows Server Operating Systems, VMware
  • Core enterprise roles such as Active Directory, Group Policy, RAIDUS PS, CAs
  • Bare metal servers and data center configurations
  • Falcon Crowdstrike
  • Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Office 365, Entra ID, Azure Sentinel
  • Hybrid cloud integrations
  • Authentication protocols
  • Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting
  • Proficient in securing firewalls, VPNs, and virtual environments (VMware/Hyper-V).
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender Suite, Cisco DNA, and Cisco ISE
  • Familiar with scripting for automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to streamline security operations
  • Deep knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps principles, and CI/CD pipeline security
  • Experience implementing TLS, SSL, VPN encryption, HSMs, and certificate lifecycle management
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams in promoting a culture of compliance and cybersecurity accountability across the enterprise.
  • Demonstrated expertise in developing, implementing, and auditing cybersecurity policies, controls, and compliance frameworks within complex IT environments.
  • Strong experience with cybersecurity risk management processes, including risk assessments, business impact analyses (BIAs), and control mapping.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in computer science/ Information Technology with a security concentration and a Master’s degree in business administration is highly desirable. Industry certifications in cybersecurity are preferred and 10 to 15 years of experience in information security. Minimum three years’ experience working with firewall, vulnerability scanning, intrusion detection products and authentication technologies and three years of experience with network security, incident response, auditing, intrusion detection, forensics, vulnerability assessments, and/or analytic tools; or equivalent combination of education and experience. One or more of the following: CISM, CISSP, CISA, CGEIT, CRISC, and, or other security certification.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$160,000-$170,000

description:
Overview

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes, que utiliza as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio. SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo, e em pensar nas melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Psicopedagogo(a). Neste papel você irá coordenar, supervisionar, encorajar e avaliar mediadores sob sua responsabilidade. Deve ser alguém que valoriza conversas respeitosas, escuta ativa e justiça.

  • Adaptar materiais e atividades pedagógicas, em português e inglês, para alunos com transtornos de aprendizagem;
  • Ter e buscar conhecimento das dificuldades, habilidades e interesses dos alunos, para fundamentar as supervisões dos mediadores;
  • Demonstrar conhecimento de ferramentas, materiais e estratégias para auxiliar o trabalho dos mediadores sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Definir objetivos diferenciados para os alunos, a partir de avaliação de seus níveis de desenvolvimento real para que possam atingir níveis desejáveis de desenvolvimento;
  • Coordenar os mediadores quanto ao planejamento de atividades de avaliação coerentes com as necessidades e habilidades dos alunos, bem como com a instrução planejada;
  • Manter comunicação frequente com Coordenadores de Atendimento, Coordenadores de Segmento e professores de alunos de seu segmento, compartilhando informações sobre o desempenho dos alunos e buscando apoio necessário;

title: Manager, Volunteer Operations
description:
Manager, Volunteer Operations

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities. In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability. Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities. We are looking for someone with strong experience in volunteer operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event, and who has practical experience working in Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management. FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time‑management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on‑site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Formando lideranças que moldam o futuro da indústria

O Programa Global Trainee da Ternium é uma das principais portas de entrada para quem busca acelerar a carreira e se desenvolver como liderança em um ambiente industrial de alta complexidade e impacto global.

Ao longo de até 24 meses , o programa oferece uma jornada intensa de desenvolvimento, com projetos reais, exposição direta a lideranças e acompanhamento estruturado, preparando talentos para assumir posições estratégicas dentro da companhia.

Mais do que um programa de entrada, o Global Trainee é uma das principais portas de crescimento dentro do Grupo Techint , do qual a Ternium faz parte. Hoje, cerca de 70% da alta liderança do grupo foi formada por esse programa - incluindo o nosso atual presidente, Máximo Vedoya .

Essa vaga funciona como um banco de talentos ativo . Durante o processo seletivo, os candidatos passam por etapas de avaliação e testes de mapeamento de habilidades, competências e perfil , permitindo uma análise aprofundada do potencial de cada participante.

Os profissionais aprovados permanecem elegíveis no banco e passam a ser chamados conforme surgem oportunidades alinhadas ao seu perfil e às necessidades da companhia, em diferentes áreas e momentos ao longo do ano.

Áreas de atuação

As oportunidades podem surgir em áreas industriais e administrativas , com atuação transversal ao negócio e forte interface com diferentes times e unidades da Ternium.

  • Formação em Engenharias, Administração , Economia , Contabilidade , Relações Internacionais , Ciências Atuariais , Comunicação , Direito , Marketing , Publicidade e Propaganda , Psicologia , Sistemas da Informação , entre outros cursos superiores;

Diferenciais do Programa

  • Trilha de desenvolvimento estruturada para formação de lideranças;

  • Projetos reais, com alta visibilidade para lideranças;

Maior siderúrgica da América Latina, a Ternium é referência em produção de aços especiais. Nossa atuação é focada no cliente, na segurança, no uso de alta tecnologia e na sustentabilidade ambiental.

Desde 2017, operamos em uma usina moderna localizada em Santa Cruz (RJ) , com capacidade para produzir até 5 milhões de toneladas de placas de aço por ano .

Atendemos às indústrias automotiva, de óleo e gás, de maquinário, linha branca, naval e de energia, em diversos continentes.

Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento local é concreto. Já investimos mais de R$ 11 bilhões no Brasil e somos a maior acionista da Usiminas , principal produtora de aços planos do país, consolidando nossa presença e relevância no setor.

Com infraestrutura integrada, incluindo porto próprio para exportação e logística ferroviária , garantimos eficiência, agilidade e qualidade ao longo de toda a cadeia produtiva.
